reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows that adding 2% nano-CeO2 to a similar FeCoNiCrMo HEA with WC refined grains and reduced porosity, and lowered friction/wear relative to the substrate, but it does not directly support the specific FeNiCrCoCu system, the 400 °C condition, the claimed uniform dispersion by the proposed mixing method, or the dislocation-pinning mechanism. The evidence is only loosely related to several key premises.
premises: Nano-CeO2 addition refines grain structure and reduces porosity in laser-clad HEA coatings
Nano-CeO2 addition reduces friction coefficient and wear amount compared to unmodified HEA
Uniform dispersion of nano-oxides can be achieved by enhanced mixing techniques
Dispersion strengthening by nano-oxides hinders dislocation motion and reduces plastic deformation
The proposed improvements are valid at ~400 °C sliding
